test_title: PYST 20: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

My friend believes in__ supernatural__ elements in the universe.
solution: The correct answer is: **Usual** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Antonym means a word that has the opposite meaning of the given word. • **Supernatural **means beyond the laws of nature or unexplainable by natural laws. (प्रकृति के नियमों से परे या प्राकृतिक नियमों द्वारा अस्पष्टीकृत) • **Example**: *The ghostly apparition appeared in the haunted house, creating an atmosphere of supernatural mystery.* • Marked option **Usual **means something that is commonly encountered, regularly occurring, or habitual. (कुछ ऐसा जो आमतौर पर सामने आता है, नियमित रूप से घटित होता है, या आदतन होता है) • **Example**: *Sally's usual breakfast consists of toast and coffee before she starts her day.* • So, the antonym of 'supernatural is usual. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Magical **means related to or having the power of magic. (जादू) • **Unkind **means not being friendly or considerate towards others. (निर्दयी) • **Unnatural **means not in accordance with nature or normal behaviour. (अस्वाभाविक) 46:T705, The correct answer is: **Who were shouting**
